verdict.rationale: Customer.io's docs describe automations as multi-step workflows with four components: trigger, goals, exit criteria and workflow steps. Automations can be triggered by events or segment entry, and multiple delays can be chained in a single Wait Until block. A community user also reports building strong workflows with it. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of conditional branching (true/false or multi-split), documented welcome/onboarding/winback examples or templates, and deeper hands-on corroboration of the workflow builder.
